permitted_base_oils_restrictions.notes: Sourced from industry standard knowledge (base oil rule of thumb for API CK-4/FA-4 packages), not from the product datasheet. Packages claiming API CK-4/FA-4 performance are typically designed for Group II/III base oils. Rule of thumb only, not a supplier statement or an API 1509 restriction. Datasheet says claims apply only 'with appropriate base oils', so confirm with Lubrizol.

open_questions: DL2-14978.pdf is a Lubrizol 'Product Data Sheet' (PDS). The credentials table has two '14.30% by weight' columns with no other header; the second column (only API FA-4, Cummins CES 20087, DDC 93K223) appears to be the CV6320 top-treat FA-4 route described in the text, but the table does not say so.

Claim codes: A -> 'approval', M -> 'meets', L ('Licensable against an active API category') -> kept as 'other', with the code recorded in the scope note (user decision 2026-10-17). Column 1 also marks API FA-4 'L' without mentioning CV6320; recorded as printed.
Treat rate printed '14.30% by weight' in the table vs '14.3wt%' in the text (same value). No SDS in the archive.
User decision 2026-10-17: 7 claims with Lubrizol code 'L' keep their claim_type; the code and its legend text are recorded in the scope note.
